### Biography
Miriam is an epidemiologist by training, with an interest in making better use of clinical trials to generate patient-relevant and actionable evidence. Her PhD research focuses on how routine data can be used to provide evidence on outcomes that cannot be evaluated in trials and to improve the statistical efficiency of clinical trials.
